title: Design Lead
description: This is a remote position. We are evolving what product design looks like at Sumara, and this is the role that leads it. The traditional product design role is built around handoff. You sketch in Figma, hand it to engineering, wait, get a build that does not match the spec, iterate, ship something close to the original idea. The handoff is where craft, speed, and intent get lost. AI tools are changing what a product designer can do. Tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, v0, and modern Figma let a designer go from idea to working prototype, and increasingly to near-production interface, faster than a traditional designer-plus-engineer pair. The handoff shrinks. The designer ships more of what they design. This role is for product designers who want to be at the front of that shift. Whether you are already experimenting with these tools or just curious and motivated to learn, we will invest in your growth, give you the time and the support, and help you evolve into what the industry is calling a design engineer. You set the pace. We are building a unified financial platform that combines trading, investing, crypto, and everyday spending into a single account. Five pillars. Different latencies, different mental models, different levels of complexity. All inside one app on a phone screen. In a product that moves people’s money, polish is not a nice-to-have. It is what makes the product trustworthy. WHAT YOU OWN The design system from scratch: components, primitives, tokens, motion language, accessibility patterns, built to scale across all five pillars End-to-end product surfaces: discovery, exploration, high-fidelity design, prototyping, partnership with engineering through to ship Animation and interaction design: gestures, transitions, micro-interactions that make the product feel alive Cross-pillar consistency: making sure trading, investing, crypto, and cards feel like one product, not five Your own evolution: pulling AI tools and frontend skills into your workflow over time so you can prototype and ship more of what you design directly You work shoulder-to-shoulder with other product designers, product managers, and engineers. You own the result, not the artifact. HOW YOU OPERATE You are curious about AI tools and excited to make them part of your workflow. Maybe you are already using Claude or Cursor on the side. Maybe you have heard about Claude Code and v0 but have not gone deep yet. Both are fine. What matters is the direction of travel. We will invest time, training, and tooling in helping you become self-sufficient at prototyping and shipping using AI. By the end of year one, you should be operating much closer to a design engineer than to a traditional product designer. That is the deal we are offering, and it is rare. title: Backend Software Engineer (Rust, Fully Remote)
description: Description MetalBear is remote-first, early-stage, and product-led. We're building mirrord, a Kubernetes development platform that lets developers and AI coding agents run code against a live cluster before it's deployed. The problem we solve is the wait. In any organization running microservices, checking whether a change actually works means building an image, pushing it, deploying to a shared environment, and waiting on a pipeline to tell you. That loop runs many times a day per engineer, and it's the single biggest tax on how fast an organization ships. With mirrord, the service runs wherever the work is already happening: on a laptop, in CI, or inside an agent's sandbox. Its traffic, environment variables, and file access are forwarded to and from a shared staging cluster, so the service behaves exactly as it would if it were deployed, without deploying it. Feedback arrives in seconds instead of minutes, against real APIs, real schemas, and real traffic rather than mocks or a hand-maintained local stack. That matters more every month, because AI agents now write a large share of the code our customers ship. An agent generating code from static files is guessing at how the rest of the system behaves, and a human has to catch the guesses. mirrord gives the agent the real context to write against and a real feedback loop to verify against, so what lands in review is something a reviewer can trust. mirrord is used by thousands of developers worldwide , including at Fortune 500 companies . The Cloud Integrations team owns features that involve automatically managing users’ cloud services (like message brokers, databases, Kubernetes resources and more) to create virtually separate environments with only minimal resource duplication. These are key features that make mirrord uniquely valuable in complex enterprise environments. What You’ll Do Contribute Rust code that creates, manages, reconfigures and adapts cloud resources. Use AI smartly to deliver high quality code, faster. Collaborate closely with our small, world-class engineering team on architecture, new feature design and infrastructure. Engage directly with users to gather requirements, develop solutions, and debug issues. Requirements At least 3 years of professional software development experience. Of which at least one year of writing production-grade Rust . Based between UTC-5 and UTC+4 Strong systems-level thinking and an ability to debug complex, distributed environments. Comfort working async in a remote-first startup environment. Familiarity with cloud-native environments (Docker, containers, Kubernetes) beyond the basics. title: Data Center Constructability Engineer
description: About the Company Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada ’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada ’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. About the Role Armada is hiring a Data Center Constructability Engineer to support the Galleon and Leviathan product lines — a brand-new capability for the company. As we scale Modular Data Center (MDC) deployments across a growing number of sites and geographies, we need someone who can own the constructability thread that runs from early site due diligence and design review through pre-construction planning, fabrication, installation, and commissioning, and make sure what gets designed can actually be built, on schedule, everywhere we operate. title: Associate Client Success Manager
description: Overview Individuals in a Client Success Management (CSM) role are responsible for the end-to-end success of a portfolio of clients, ensuring strong adoption of the Origami platform and measurable business outcomes. Acting as strategic partners and trusted advocates, CSMs build relationships across client organizations - from day-to-day users to executive and economic buyers - to drive adoption, satisfaction, retention, and growth. CSMs proactively guide client goals internally, orchestrating cross-functional teams across multiple workstreams to deliver a seamless client experience. Through data-driven insights, industry expertise, and proactive communication, CSMs align internal teams and client stakeholders to foster long-term value realization. Starting base pay for this role is between $77,000 and $97,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities Client Advocacy & Strategic Partnership Serves as a primary point of contact for assigned client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the client lifecycle. Builds and maintains strong relationships with client stakeholders across operational, managerial, and executive levels. Understands client business objectives, success criteria, and organizational priorities to align Origami solutions accordingly. Represents the client internally, ensuring their goals, challenges, and feedback are understood and addressed. Adoption, Value Realization & Success Planning Drives adoption of Origami solutions by aligning product capabilities with client use cases and workflows. Develops and maintains client success plans that define goals, milestones, and measurable business outcomes. QBRs/SBRs) to communicate value realized, progress against goals, and future opportunities. Partners with internal teams to ensure smooth transitions between lifecycle phases and continuity of client experience. Collaborates with Account Management on retention, growth opportunities, and long-term account strategy. description: The Problem Worth Solving Generative AI is a powerful reasoning engine — but it operates blind inside enterprise software. It can't map a million-line multi-technologies codebase, trace cross-technology dependencies, or quantify technical debt. When asked to help modernize a legacy application, it guesses. The industry's answer has been RAG and vector databases. Useful — but approximate. Semantic similarity is not the same as architectural truth. CAST 's answer: give AI the exact structural blueprint of the application, derived deterministically from source code analysis across 150+ technologies. Not approximations. Actual call graphs, dependency maps, transaction flows — the ground truth of how software actually works. We call this Software Intelligence. We're now building the bridge that puts it directly in the hands of AI agents. You'll drive what data gets exposed, how agents consume it, and what new capabilities this unlocks for developers, architects, and transformation teams. Hyperscaler partnerships . You'll manage and grow technical integrations with AWS and Google Cloud. Our published research with Google has already demonstrated that augmenting Gemini with CAST 's structural analysis produces measurably deeper results on enterprise codebases. You'll be the product owner turning that into a repeatable offering. GSI co-innovation. Tier-1 global system integrators are at the forefront of industrializing AI in the software development lifecycle — at enterprise scale, across industries. You'll work directly with them to understand where AI-driven modernization breaks down in practice, what's missing, and where CAST intelligence fills the gap. They're one of your best proxies for real market needs, and a source of product ideas you won't find in analyst reports. Next-generation retrieval. Our research team is actively exploring approaches that go beyond standard RAG — combining deterministic structural graphs with semantic retrieval to give agents richer, more grounded context. title: Real Estate Advisor (Dilbeek)
description: Wil jij je eerste commerciële stappen zetten in de vastgoedwereld? Ben jij iemand die energie krijgt van klantencontact, onderhandelen en resultaat behalen? En zoek je een plek waar je zonder ervaring kan uitgroeien tot vastgoedmakelaar? Over de klant Onze klant is een sterke, groeiende speler in de Belgische vastgoedmarkt. Je komt terecht in een gedreven, warme en ondernemende omgeving waar je de ruimte krijgt om te leren, te groeien en impact te maken. Met een stevige structuur en een team dat voor je klaarstaat, bouw je stap voor stap aan je carrière. Wat houdt de functie in? Je gebruikt je commerciële mindset en vlotte babbel om klanten op een natuurlijke manier te adviseren. Je bouwt vertrouwen op met klanten en onderhoudt duurzame relaties. Je zet je energie voor targets en onderhandelingen in om deals succesvol af te ronden. Je bent ondernemend en leergierig en ontwikkelt jezelf dagelijks in de vastgoedwereld. Requirements Je hebt een natuurlijke commerciële flair en communiceert vlot en helder. Je bent empathisch, dienstgericht en weet snel vertrouwen op te bouwen. Je werkt flexibel , omdat je begrijpt dat klanten soms buiten kantooruren geholpen willen worden. Je haalt energie uit resultaten behalen en vindt onderhandelen leuk. Je bent proactief, leergierig en wil doorgroeien in vastgoed. Je straalt professionaliteit uit in gedrag en communicatie. Je werkt sterk in team, maar ook zelfstandig wanneer nodig. Wat betekent dit voor jou? Een intensief opleidingsprogramma via een interne Academy om snel door te groeien. Een aantrekkelijk verdienmodel met bedrijfswagen en commissies op basis van je eigen resultaten. De kans om je eigen portefeuille en klantenbestand uit te bouwen. Een dynamisch, ondersteunend team en een organisatie met sterke naam en structuur. Een werkregio dicht bij huis, zodat je je eigen netwerk slim kan inzetten. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: About Feanix Bio Feanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up. We’re a YC-backed startup using whole-genome sequencing and custom ML models to help dairy farmers make better breeding and herd management decisions. Our technology is genuinely novel: we can sequence a full genome from a single hair at a fraction of traditional industry costs, our models achieve ~90% prediction accuracy on traits where existing approaches sit closer to ~30%, and we’re pioneering farm-specific genomic predictions that turn genetics into practical, actionable decisions. That technology is translating into real adoption. In a short time, we’ve grown to serve roughly 1% of the U.S. dairy industry, with many customers in the pipeline. We started with dairy because our founders grew up on dairy farms and understand firsthand the problems we’re solving. But genetics is foundational to every agricultural industry, and dairy is only the beginning. We’re building Feanix with a small, high-caliber team where people have meaningful ownership and work end to end. There are no unnecessary layers and very little room for busywork — just difficult problems at the intersection of biology, data, and software that haven’t been solved before. If you’re exceptional at what you do and want your work to have a measurable impact on an entire industry, we’d love to build it with you. About The Role Sales at Feanix has been carried this far by founder-led selling, and it works: our CEO closes profit-driven dairies in one to two meetings by finding money the farm is leaving on the table in its own data. What we haven't yet built is a sales organization that closes at that standard without a founder in the room. This role builds it. You'll be our senior sales leader, reporting directly to the CEO, and you'll operate as a player-coach from day one. The player half: personally running deals against our target market — dairy operations of 8,000+ cows run as businesses, where the owner makes decisions on profit — and proving our sales motion converts repeatably. The coach half: turning the sellers we already have into closers, building the process, capacity, and accountability that make the number happen every month, and hiring the team that scales it. The bar here is specific, and it is not the industry's bar. Traditional agricultural sales accepts that a deal takes six meetings and a season of relationship-building. We close in one or two, because the meeting itself creates the urgency: we open the farm's own records, show the specific cows and specific dollars being lost, and make the cost of waiting explicit. Your job is to make that motion teachable — problem first, the prospect's own data second, features last — and to hold every seller to it. You'll also own the commercial system around that motion: how we price, how we package, and how we expand revenue once we're inside a farm. title: Independent Contractor (Spanish/English) Transcription/Translation
description: What you will do: As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material. We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription. Who we’re looking for: U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9. Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English. Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question. People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed. Requirements Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions. Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence. What you will need A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary. For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to. Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word. ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing. How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist? No calls, please. File your online application here and include: Current resume (PDF) Cover letter (PDF) A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy) Originally posted on Himalayas
